articles.h: Globally Rejustered Patent Catalog opens its doors — site 8 of 27
body: The Globally Rejustered Patent Catalog launched today, joining the Signature network as site 8 of 27. Real harvested public patent records across every field of invention.
Like every site in the network, it ships with its full apparatus: its records, its tools, and its AI helper, all marching toward one million files.
The launch is one more step in the network's standing order: expand and expand, with growth always sideways and no data ever cut.

articles.h: Signature Spec Catalog Pending Patents: fresh draft specs land in today's drip
